notesForTheReviewer: One gap I record rather than raise, because the code is right and is not this change's: the retag procedure's strongest step now rests on rereadRetag's exit 1 when the kind read back is not the one written (secret_retag.go:183-186), and no test in cmd/agent-secrets names that path or its message. The guide calls exit 0 'the strongest statement the broker makes about a name' and a person storing an App key acts on it, so a regression there would be caught by nothing and would end in a raw key reaching an agent. Pinning it needs a store whose metadata read can be made stale, which the fake store cannot be, so it is a rig to build rather than a row to add.

The alarm table and the guide now list the same five lines and agree on which two name a secret. They are two copies of one fact; the Fast-follow item about stating the fan-out's guarantee once covers the same shape, and this is one more place it would cover.

My harnesses on this pod's volume classify the watchdog's exit by its log text and were updated to the new wording this round. Anyone re-running $TMPDIR/hand/watchdog_two.sh against an older build will see every run counted 'other'; that is the harness, not the build.
